propositions: git commit --amend -F FILE replaces the entire commit message and drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a new Change-Id and create a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
prepare-commit-msg hook cannot detect amend operations with -F flag (reports source='message' identically to fresh -F commits) so a hook-based fix is infeasible
A make amend-msg FILE=<path> wrapper must preserve the existing Change-Id from HEAD when amending with a new message file, matching prior art from Go, OpenStack, Android, and Chromium projects
make amend-msg must fail loudly and non-zero when HEAD carries no Change-Id rather than silently producing a commit that will be stamped with a fresh Change-Id
AGENTS.md documentation must be updated to name make amend-msg as the path for rewritten commit messages and explicitly warn that --amend -m/-F drop the Change-Id and create duplicate Gerrit changes
